location: Sky Lagoon middle meadow / former playground footprint
editorial_note: REAPER item/region times read locally. Shot coverage and assignment of first break to King, second to Prince and final to both are authored editorial choices, not inferred voice identities. No REAPER modification. Story coda follows music and intentional player completion.

scenes.title: Ready in the middle meadow
scenes.action: Both bands settle; Roshan raises her sticks. Candle remains on cake.

scenes.title: Roshan starts the groove
scenes.action: Two clear tom contacts and rebound; relaxed happy expression.

scenes.title: Daddy answers on ukulele
scenes.action: Four-string ukulele strum, warm look toward Roshan; kit stays left.

scenes.title: Baby Eagle holds the bass line
scenes.action: Wing plucks bass; exactly four strings and four tuning pegs remain connected.

scenes.title: King first grindcore break
scenes.action: King leans into his lead guitar, theatrical open-mouth growl; Prince supports on drums.

scenes.title: Roshan answers without fear
scenes.action: Roshan gives a small tom fill, then returns to the folk groove.

scenes.title: Family call and response
scenes.action: Daddy and Eagle answer Roshan together; King watches the prize.

scenes.title: Prince second grindcore break
scenes.action: Prince plays an exuberant two-stick fill around many toms and cymbals. One kick only.

scenes.title: Everyone finds the groove again
scenes.action: Roshan and Eagle trade drum/bass responses; Daddy and the Ember band remain outside this closer framing.

scenes.title: Roshan completes her phrase
scenes.action: Roshan lands her cadence; delight, not failure. Candle still safely on cake.

scenes.title: Ember final interruption
scenes.action: King and Prince deliver the final blast together; King eyes the candle after his flourish.

scenes.title: The King cheats
scenes.action: Music has ended. King drops his guitar and loose strap onto the stage, reaches over, closes his fingers around the candle body and lifts it off the cake by hand. No magic.

beats.action: Release guitar; it lands on stage with strap loose. Music is already over.
Reach and close fingers/thumb around the candle body; cake stays supported.
Lift the one candle by hand; empty place on intact cake; guitar stays on floor.

scenes.title: The Prince objects
scenes.action: Prince has set sticks down offscreen; he appeals with an empty hand, then follows the King carrying the single candle. The dropped guitar and slack strap stay on stage; neither character carries it.

scenes.title: Friends stay together
scenes.action: With the Embers already gone, Daddy and Eagle stay beside Roshan; cake and earned rewards remain. The dropped guitar remains on stage outside this closer framing; no retrieval or second guitar.
